checks.command: python3 verification/8/checks/ac9_plain_words.py + Playwright screenshots in verification/8/*.png
harness run by hand: 50 items x 5 comments

notes: Check was not separate: the Verifier ran in the same account and session as the builder (prototype profile, no TEAM_CHECKER).
AC5: every error message is two short sentences ('The board can't reach GitHub. Check your internet connection.'); the clause says one plain sentence. Plain and jargon-free, so a note, not a finding.
AC3: the card shows the latest team comment's header rewritten in plain words ('Rohan posted a report.') rather than the raw header line; accepted because AC9 forbids label names on the first screen.
AC2: reason is the first line after the header; the clause's 'her first line' is ambiguous and the check accepts this reading.
AC6: 'if masking fails, the whole line is hidden' was not tested black-box (no way to force the mask to fail from outside).
Untested: a project with more than 100 open items or 100 comments per item (no paging); the page's behaviour when the board server itself stops.
In the error state the header still says 'Last checked just now' (the time of the failed try); no stale cards are shown.
